brief.topic: Open-source knowledge / agent-brain tools and their coverage of ZKnowledgeCompounding research topics (dual-track static/dynamic capture, lifecycle/decay modeling, distillation to meta-cognition, context topology, resource-aware scheduling, retrieval/reuse, local-first)

criteria.question: What storage model does the project use (graph DB, document+vector, embedded local, server)?
Does it model knowledge as a graph (nodes/edges/triplets) or as documents?
How does it orchestrate LLMs (local, cloud, agent framework)?
Does it model lifecycle, decay, versioning, or temporality of knowledge?
How does it organize knowledge (topics, ontology, taxonomy, bi-temporal)?
What retrieval capabilities does it offer (semantic, graph, hybrid, natural-language)?
Does it have scheduling, attention, or recall mechanisms?
Is it local-first, self-hostable, or offline-capable?
